name: Moam
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/ruins-of-ahnqiraj/moam.md (no Era HP: wiki 340,000 versus SoM 799,500; the boss's HP here is a clock). ESTIMATES: the Reservoir is a 44 yd round room with an entrance south; the fight is 90 s active, then a 60 s stone phase (real: up to 90 s, ending early when all three fiends die or his mana fills), then 90 s more until he dies, with HP 100-58, held at 58, then 58-0 (the 58 is a placeholder; the wiki's 'under 45% by 90 s' is a target, not a clock, and this model cannot end the stone phase early). Boss melee (600 per 2 s) with Trample (1,000 on the tank every 15 s) is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank lives on the raid's passive healing and dies if a player healer ignores it (`healPerSecondWithPlayerHealer` 110); guides call his melee low, so this is mostly placeholder. Trample uses the spell data's self-centred 10 yd radius, set as 6 yd from his 4.5 yd hitbox edge (TenTonHammer says a front arc). Mana is the fight and the engine has no mana bar. The model: for the ranged role only (the drainers), a `manaDrain` `hazard` lands on them every 14 s (real Drain Mana is 500 from six players every 2 to 6 s) and `applies` `manaSurge`, a magic `debuff` meaning 'he is filling up', cleared by the ranged role's Dispel button, relabelled Mana Burn / Viper Sting. `arcaneEruption` (3,500, room-wide, the middle of 3,063-3,937, with a radial 8 yd `knockback` standing in for the launch; knock-up fall damage is not modelled and 45 yd is simply 'the room') is `conditional: debuff:manaSurge` and only fires while it is up, so it happens if the drainer has not burned him down. The non-drainer roles never get the debuff and never see an Eruption: the raid's other drainers are assumed to be doing their job, which matches a clean kill. This misrepresents the real mana race (his mana total, 26,200, and drain arithmetic of up to 6,000 per cast are not simulated); the Eruption is a punishment for a missed press, not a mana bar reaching full. The hazard ring under the ranged player only exists to deliver the debuff. Stone phase: `bossState: submerged` for 60 s, hp held at 58%, no melee and no threat, ranged keep burning (Moam regains mana in stone in the real fight, hence the same `manaDrain` and Eruption chain with `requires: any`). Three Mana Fiends are `killFirst` adds from front/left/right of him, ~15,000 HP real, modelled by a 30 s lifetime, held by whichever tank role plays; the real banish-two-kill-one assignment has no representation, nor does breaking the stone phase by killing all three. Fiend Arcane Explosion (~1,000, 2 s telegraphed) is a random `hazard` plus a light raid-wide pulse (the pulse is not real: it keeps the healer working while Moam is stone, since adds cannot hurt the tank in this engine). Fiend Counterspell (12 s, wiki and Wowhead guide; Wowhead's NPC page lists only Arcane Explosion, which is weak evidence against it altogether) is a `debuff` with `forbidAbilities` for 12 s on a random caster role: pressing during it is scored (`castIntoCounterspell`) instead of being a lockout per school. Waking he resets threat (a one-shot `threatWipe` at phase start, TenTonHammer's 'no aggro table'). Double Attack (CMaNGOS) is folded into melee. The 2 to 3 s delay for mana users entering at the pull is represented by `holdAfterPull` and the `earlyAttacks` metric, and only the ranged role is held to it by the `manaWait` expectation; melee go in with the tank. UNVERIFIED: whether Moam is immune or merely reduced while stoned. Wowhead spell 25685 gives Mod Damage Taken -50 (all schools), while the wiki and Wowhead guide say immune; the phase clock hides the difference and Fiends first is correct either way.

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Pull him facing north and hold him there. Nothing to swap. At 90 s he turns to stone: pick up the Mana Fiends with the off-tank, and be standing on him when he wakes, because his threat is empty.

offtank.label: Fiend off-tank
offtank.description: Your whole job is the Mana Fiends: grab them when he turns to stone and hold them off the raid while the DPS kill them.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Behind him. Trample hits within 10 yards, so stay healed. Kill the Mana Fiends first when he turns to stone.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: You are a drainer. Mana Burn or Viper Sting him whenever he starts to fill: leave it and Arcane Eruption hits the raid for 3,500. Kill Mana Fiends during the stone phase.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Keep the tank up through melee and Trample. A Counterspell locks you out for a few seconds in the stone phase: time it so the tank is high when it lands.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Mana Burn / Viper Sting
dispel.tip: Mana Burn, Viper Sting or Drain Mana on Moam. Press it whenever he starts filling.

manaDrain.label: Drain Mana
manaDrain.tip: He drains mana and his bar climbs. Burn him down with your Mana Burn or Viper Sting.

manaSurge.label: Moam is filling up
manaSurge.tip: Press Mana Burn or Viper Sting now, or he erupts.

arcaneEruption.label: Arcane Eruption
arcaneEruption.tip: He reached full mana. Everything within 45 yards takes about 3,500 and is launched.

trample.label: Trample
trample.tip: Weapon-damage stomp within 10 yards. The tank and melee just heal through it.

submerge.label: Energize: he turns to stone
submerge.tip: At 90 s he turns to stone for up to 90 s and summons three Mana Fiends.

emerge.label: Moam wakes
emerge.tip: He wakes from stone with an empty threat table.

manaFiends.label: Mana Fiends
manaFiends.tip: Three Mana Fiends spawn around him. Pick them up and kill them.

fiendExplosion.label: Arcane Explosion
fiendExplosion.tip: A Fiend detonates near someone. Step out of the ring.

fiendPulse.label: Fiend blasts
fiendPulse.tip: The Fiends blast the raid. Heal through it.

counterspell.label: Counterspell
counterspell.tip: A Fiend Counterspells you for 12 seconds. Press nothing until it ends.

awakeWipe.label: Moam wakes
awakeWipe.toast: He is awake: threat wiped. Tank, take him!
awakeWipe.tip: He wakes with an empty threat table. Tank first, then everyone.

expectations.label: Pull him facing north
expectations.tip: Face him away from the raid so a Trample or Eruption throw hits as few as possible.

expectations.label: Mana users wait a few seconds on the pull
expectations.tip: Let the tank and melee in first. He has no target to drain for the first seconds.

expectations.label: Be ready beside him for the Fiends
expectations.tip: When he turns to stone the Fiends spawn around him. Stand ready for the grab.

expectations.label: Burn his mana before he erupts
expectations.tip: Mana Burn or Viper Sting him the moment he starts to fill. Leave it up and Arcane Eruption hits the whole raid.

expectations.label: Keep him from filling up
expectations.tip: Every Eruption is 3,500 to the raid. Burn him on the note.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Mostly melee and Trample: keep the tank topped.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Top up before the next Trample.

expectations.label: Pick up the Mana Fiends
expectations.tip: Grab them as they spawn and hold them off the raid. Kill one if they cannot be banished.

expectations.label: Kill the Mana Fiends first
expectations.tip: Fiends first: he is stunned and regaining mana, and sources disagree on whether he takes damage.

expectations.label: Step out of the Fiend Explosion ring
expectations.tip: A ring means a Fiend is about to blow. Step out now.

expectations.label: Do not press under Counterspell
expectations.tip: Wait for the 12 seconds to end. Pressing into it only wastes your Global.

expectations.label: Burn his mana before he erupts
expectations.tip: Mana Burn or Viper Sting him the moment he starts to fill. Leave it up and Arcane Eruption hits the whole raid.

expectations.label: Keep him from filling up
expectations.tip: Every Eruption is 3,500 to the raid. Burn him on the note.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Moam is stone but the tank still gets hit by the Fiends here.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Fiends bite. Keep them above half.

expectations.label: Take him the moment he wakes
expectations.tip: Be next to him when he wakes. Threat is empty, so he goes for whoever hits him.

expectations.label: Stay beside him for the next stone
expectations.tip: He will turn to stone again at the next cycle. Be ready.

expectations.label: Burn his mana before he erupts
expectations.tip: Mana Burn or Viper Sting him the moment he starts to fill. Leave it up and Arcane Eruption hits the whole raid.

expectations.label: Keep him from filling up
expectations.tip: Every Eruption is 3,500 to the raid. Burn him on the note.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: After the stone phase his threat is empty and he wakes fast.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Top up before the next Trample.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

attacksOffPriority.label: Boss attacks while a priority add was alive
attacksOffPriority.tip: Face the add and kill it first. The boss can wait.

whelpsOnRaid.label: Adds loose on the raid
whelpsOnRaid.tip: Grab the adds before they reach a raid member and keep them on you.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with Moam filling up
debuffSeconds.tip: Mana Burn him the moment the debuff lands.

eruptionsTaken.label: Arcane Eruptions you caused
eruptionsTaken.tip: Press Mana Burn on the note. Every Eruption is 3,500 to the whole raid.

castIntoCounterspell.label: Pressed into Counterspell
castIntoCounterspell.tip: Counterspell means press nothing for the 12 seconds.

cues.notes: Mana Burn when he starts filling; Taunt when he wakes; grab the Fiends; heal when low.

list.label: Taunt when Moam turns on the raid
list.tip: Taunt as soon as the boss turns toward the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Grab the Mana Fiends
list.tip: Pick them up and hold them off the raid.

list.label: Mana Burn: he is filling up
list.tip: Press Mana Burn or Viper Sting right now.

drills.name: Stone and wake
drills.description: He turns to stone every 22 s and wakes with no threat. Taunt him the moment he wakes.

drills.name: Burn his mana
drills.description: He starts filling every 8 s. Mana Burn the moment the debuff lands. Leave it and he erupts.

drills.name: Trample and Fiends
drills.description: Trample every 9 s and Fiend blasts near you: keep your feet out of the rings and keep swinging.

drills.name: Fiend pickup
drills.description: Three Fiends spawn around him every 20 s. Grab them and hold them.

drills.name: Heal through Fiend pulses
drills.description: Fiend blasts every 6 s with Counterspell mixed in. Keep the tank high.

limitations: Moam has no mana resource. The Mana Drain button does not control his mana or trigger his phase change.
